stores.create_description: A new store with its own products, domain and settings.
stores.error_limit: Your plan does not allow another store ({used} of {limit} used).
stores.error_taken: This address is already used by another store.
stores.error_invalid: Use 3 to 40 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens. Some names are reserved.
stores.error_generic: The store could not be created. Try again.
stores.page_subtitle: Every store of your account, its address and its publication state.
stores.history_failed: The history could not be loaded.
stores.confirm_published_description: Its public pages go online at its address.
stores.confirm_suspended_description: Visitors see an "unavailable" page. Orders, products and settings are kept; you can reactivate it at any time.
stores.confirm_archived_description: It disappears from the public web. Its orders and logs are kept.
stores.action_failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
stores.delete_description: Only an archived store that never received an order can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
stores.delete_refused: This store cannot be deleted: it has orders, is not archived, or is your only store.

wizard.title: Create a sales channel
wizard.subtitle: A few steps: type, details, products, delivery and template. Nothing is created until you confirm.

store.name: Online store
store.description: A full store with home page, catalogue, product pages, cart and checkout.
store.features: Several products · categories · featured products on the home page

landing.name: Landing page
landing.description: A sales page built around one main product.
landing.features: One product · gallery · offer · order form

wizard.id_note: A unique identifier is generated for the channel when it is created.
wizard.products_hint: Choose the catalogue products this store shows. You can change the selection later.
wizard.delivery_hint: Choose the delivery modes this store offers. Fees come from your account’s shipping profiles.
wizard.profile_label: Shipping profile used by this store

theme01.name: Classic store
theme01.description: Violet and amber, every home-page section: hero, categories, best sellers, how it works, new arrivals, features, promotion and reviews.

boutique.name: Fashion boutique
boutique.description: Charcoal and gold on cream, Tajawal font. Opens on a fashion photo and the new arrivals — made for clothing, bags and accessories.

electro.name: High-tech
electro.description: Blue and cyan, IBM Plex font. A tech banner, then the store's strengths and best sellers — made for electronics and gadgets.

landing01.name: Product landing page
landing01.description: Banner, product presentation, gallery, benefits, price, order form, FAQ and reassurance.

flash.name: Flash offer
flash.description: Red and yellow, Almarai font. Price and order form right under the banner, benefits already written — made for a limited-time offer.

problem.subdomain_invalid: Use 3 to 40 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens. Some names are reserved.
problem.no_delivery_mode: Offer at least one delivery mode.
problem.main_product_required: Choose the main product of the landing page.
problem.domain_invalid: Enter a domain like www.myshop.dz, or leave the field empty.

wizard.error_network: The store could not be created (network). Your answers are kept: try again.
wizard.done_body: It starts as a draft: publish it from the Stores page when it is ready, and it goes online at its address.
wizard.error_products: Some selected products are no longer in the catalogue. Check your selection and try again.
wizard.error_profile: This shipping profile no longer exists. Choose another one and try again.
wizard.error_template: This template is not available for this channel type. Choose another one.
wizard.error_forbidden: Only an account administrator can create a store.
wizard.done_existing: This store had already been created by an earlier attempt, with the answers given then. Change its settings from its dashboard.
wizard.products_hint_landing: Choose the one catalogue product this landing page sells. You can replace it later.

aventy.title: Welcome from Aventy.
aventy.body: Your Aventy products are in your catalogue: choose the ones this channel sells.

wizard.custom_domain_hint: If you already have a domain. It goes online once its DNS points at the platform; you can also add it later from Domains.
wizard.error_domain_taken: This domain is already used by another channel.
wizard.done_live: It is online at its address.
wizard.done_domain: {domain} is waiting for its DNS: point it at the platform, then verify it from the Domains page.
